titleEn: The surprising origins of Denmark’s reputation for open-mindedness
titleZh: 丹麦开放包容形象背后，出人意料的历史起源
method: Machine reference translation with paragraph alignment; not manually certified.

paragraphs.en: Ask Danes what makes Denmark Danish and you might hear about openness, tolerance and the freedom to live as you choose.
paragraphs.zh: 问丹麦人是什么让丹麦成为丹麦人，你可能会听到开放、宽容和自由选择生活的声音。

paragraphs.en: You can see it in the country’s history: Denmark was the first country in the world to legalise pornography. Alternative communities such as Christiania in Copenhagen are internationally famous for their counterculture and liberal attitudes. And Danish activists have helped push ideas about sexuality and family life in new directions.
paragraphs.zh: 你可以从这个国家的历史中看到这一点：丹麦是世界上第一个将色情合法化的国家。像哥本哈根的克里斯蒂安尼亚这样的另类社区以其反主流文化和自由主义态度而闻名于世。丹麦的活动家们帮助推动了关于性和家庭生活的新观念。

paragraphs.en: But there is a less obvious part of this story.
paragraphs.zh: 但这个故事还有一个不太明显的部分。

paragraphs.en: Denmark did not develop its reputation for open-mindedness entirely on its own. Some of the people who helped create that image were looking at Denmark from across the border.
paragraphs.zh: 丹麦并不是完全靠自己的力量建立起开明的名声的，一些帮助创造这种形象的人是从边境那边观察丹麦的。

paragraphs.en: From the 1960s onwards, West Germany became an important audience for Denmark’s emerging reputation as a more liberal society. For young Germans frustrated with what they saw as a conservative, hierarchical and authoritarian society, Denmark looked like a place where people had more freedom to experiment with different ways of living.
paragraphs.zh: 从20世纪60年代开始，丹麦逐渐成为一个更加自由的社会，西德德国成了它的重要受众。对于德国年轻人来说，丹麦在他们眼中是一个保守、等级森严和专制的社会，他们感到沮丧。在那里，人们有更多的自由去尝试不同的生活方式。

paragraphs.en: West Germany in the 1960s and 1970s was still grappling with the legacy of Nazism. Many young people in the West German New Left rejected the social and political values of their parents’ generation and looked for alternatives.
paragraphs.zh: 上世纪六七十年代的德国仍在与纳粹主义的遗产作斗争，西德新左派的许多年轻人拒绝了父辈的社会和政治价值观，寻找替代品。

paragraphs.en: The situation was also different across the German divide. In East Germany, the communist state offered its own very different model of society and controlled many aspects of public and private life.
paragraphs.zh: 在东德，共产主义国家提供了自己非常不同的社会模式，并控制着公共和私人生活的许多方面。

paragraphs.en: For young West Germans seeking alternatives, Denmark seemed like something else entirely: a nearby democratic country where social experimentation seemed possible.
paragraphs.zh: 对于寻求替代方案的年轻西德人来说，丹麦似乎完全是另一回事：一个附近的民主国家，在那里似乎可以进行社会实验。

paragraphs.en: Research I am carrying out with my colleague Tobias Haimin de Fønss Wung-Sung into West German reactions to Denmark during this period shows how several aspects of Danish life contributed to this image.
paragraphs.zh: 我和同事托比亚斯·海敏·德·冯斯·翁-松（Tobias Haimin de Fønss Wung-Sung）对这一时期西德对丹麦的反应进行了研究，研究表明丹麦生活的几个方面如何促成了这一形象。

paragraphs.en: Christiania, the self-governing community in Copenhagen, became associated with communal living and alternative lifestyles. The New Left political movement challenged established politics and social norms. Roskilde music festival grew into an important gathering place for young people and counterculture. Denmark also experimented with progressive approaches to education and pornography.
paragraphs.zh: 哥本哈根的自治社区克里斯蒂安尼亚（Christiania）与社区生活和另类生活方式联系在一起。新左派政治运动挑战了既定的政治和社会规范。罗斯基勒音乐节（Roskilde music festival）发展成为年轻人和反主流文化的重要聚集地。丹麦还尝试了对教育和色情的进步方法。

paragraphs.en: From abroad, this created an image of Denmark as a country where people were unusually free to live differently.
paragraphs.zh: 在国外，这给丹麦树立了一个形象，在这个国家，人们可以自由地过不同的生活。

paragraphs.en: ‘A porn paradise’
paragraphs.zh: "色情天堂"

paragraphs.en: In 1969, when the Danish parliament legalised pornographic images , its decision was highly controversial among Danes. But it attracted considerable attention internationally, particularly in West Germany, where the new government under Chancellor Willy Brandt prepared a similar reform.
paragraphs.zh: 1969年，丹麦议会将色情图像合法化，这一决定在丹麦人中引起了极大的争议。但它在国际上引起了相当大的关注，特别是在西德国，在那里，总理维利·勃兰特领导下的新政府准备进行类似的改革。

paragraphs.en: The result was not simply a change in Danish law. People, products and money began moving across the border.
paragraphs.zh: 其结果不仅仅是丹麦法律的改变，人们、产品和资金开始越过边境。

paragraphs.en: Government officials travelled to Copenhagen to learn about the effects of the liberalisation. West Germans travelled to Denmark to buy pornography. Danish producers gained access to a much larger market south of the border. Denmark could even be imagined in West Germany as a kind of porn paradise.
paragraphs.zh: 政府官员前往哥本哈根了解自由化的影响。西德人前往丹麦购买色情作品。丹麦生产商获得了进入边境以南更大市场的机会。丹麦甚至可以想象在西德国是一种色情天堂。

paragraphs.en: Our research into West German reactions to Denmark’s liberalisation between 1965 and 1985 shows how the country became associated with a new kind of sexual freedom.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对西德对1965年至1985年丹麦自由化的反应的研究表明，这个国家是如何与一种新的性自由联系在一起的。

paragraphs.en: Danish homosexual people and activists also developed connections with larger gay communities in West Germany, particularly in Berlin and Hamburg. And Denmark developed its own naturist culture, not least inspired by the German movement of freikörperkultur (pronounced FRY-kur-per-kul-toor) or “free body culture”. People gathered to swim, sunbathe and socialise naked.
paragraphs.zh: 丹麦的同性恋者和活动家也与西德国更大的同性恋社区建立了联系，特别是在柏林和汉堡。丹麦发展了自己的裸体主义文化，尤其是受到德国freikörperkultur运动（发音为FRY-kur-per-kul-toor）或"自由身体文化"的启发。人们聚集在一起游泳，日光浴和裸体社交。

paragraphs.en: People, ideas and practices were therefore moving in both directions across the border.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，人员、思想和做法都在跨越边界双向流动。

paragraphs.en: Reputation and national values
paragraphs.zh: 声誉和国家价值观

paragraphs.en: Over time, these developments helped turn Denmark’s reputation for social liberalism into something more than an international image. It became part of how Denmark could describe itself.
paragraphs.zh: 随着时间的推移，这些发展帮助丹麦的社会自由主义声誉不仅仅是一种国际形象，它还成为丹麦自我描述的一部分。

paragraphs.en: In 2016, for example, the Danish government asked the public to identify values considered particularly important to Danish society. The resulting Danmarkskanon, or Danish Canon, included ten such values. One was frisind (pronounced free-sin) – a word that can mean open-mindedness, tolerance or freedom from conventional moral constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，2016年，丹麦政府要求公众确定对丹麦社会特别重要的价值观。由此产生的Danmarkskanon（丹麦法典）包括十种价值观。其中一种是frisind（发音为free-sin）--这个词可以表示思想开放、宽容或摆脱传统道德约束的自由。

paragraphs.en: The Canon described frisind in terms of openness towards traditional moral ideas, the body and sexuality. It pointed to Denmark’s relaxed attitude towards nudity, tolerance of different forms of family and sexual life, alternative lifestyles and the legalisation of pornography.
paragraphs.zh: 《圣典》从对传统道德观念、身体和性的开放性方面描述了弗里斯兰，指出丹麦对裸体的宽松态度，对不同形式的家庭和性生活的宽容，另类的生活方式和色情的合法化。

paragraphs.en: By this point, what had once been a contested and internationally shaped reputation had become something that could be presented as part of Denmark’s cultural heritage. But that does not necessarily mean Danes have always been uniquely tolerant.
paragraphs.zh: 至此，曾经备受争议、在国际上影响深远的声誉已经成为丹麦文化遗产的一部分，但这并不一定意味着丹麦人一直都是独一无二的宽容者。

paragraphs.en: The Danish criminologist Berl Kutchinsky (1935-1995) studied the liberalisation of pornography extensively and he was sceptical of precisely this idea. He argued that Denmark’s exceptional liberalism was something of a myth.
paragraphs.zh: 丹麦犯罪学家贝尔·库钦斯基（Berl Kutchinsky，1935-1995）对色情自由化进行了广泛的研究，他对这种观点持怀疑态度。他认为，丹麦特殊的自由主义是一个神话。

paragraphs.en: In his view, Danes still belonged to the broadly “puritanical, post-Victorian” family of European nations. Denmark was simply among the less puritanical members of that group, alongside Sweden, the Netherlands and Germany. Compared with them, he considered Danes “slightly more liberal and permissive” when it came to sexuality.
paragraphs.zh: 在他看来，丹麦人仍然属于广泛的“后维多利亚时代清教徒”欧洲国家。丹麦只是这个群体中不那么清教徒的成员之一，与瑞典、荷兰和德国相比，他认为丹麦人在性方面“稍微更自由和宽容”。

paragraphs.en: If Kutchinsky was right, Danish frisind is less about being uniquely liberal than about being liberal in comparison with particular neighbours.
paragraphs.zh: 如果库钦斯基是对的，那么丹麦的弗里斯兰与其说是独特的自由主义，不如说是与特定邻国相比的自由主义。

paragraphs.en: Somewhere else
paragraphs.zh: 别的地方

paragraphs.en: The history of Danish frisind therefore stretches well beyond Denmark.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，丹麦弗里斯兰的历史远远超出了丹麦。

paragraphs.en: And while it has been shaped by changing laws and attitudes inside the country, people travelling across the border, activists building international networks and products finding new markets have also played a role.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然它是由国内不断变化的法律和态度塑造的，但跨境旅行的人们、建立国际网络的活动人士以及寻找新市场的产品也发挥了作用。

paragraphs.en: That is easy to lose sight of once an idea becomes part of a national identity.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦一个想法成为国家认同的一部分，这一点就很容易被忽视。

paragraphs.en: The Danish Canon presents frisind as a Danish value. But its history suggests something more complicated: Denmark’s reputation for open-mindedness was, at least partly, made through its relationships with other countries.
paragraphs.zh: 《丹麦正典》将frisind描述为丹麦的价值观，但它的历史表明了一些更复杂的东西：丹麦思想开放的声誉至少部分是通过与其他国家的关系建立起来的。

paragraphs.en: In other words, one of the very things Denmark considers particularly Danish likely started out more as a comparison with somewhere else.
paragraphs.zh: 换句话说，丹麦认为特别丹麦的一件事可能更多地是从与其他地方的比较开始的。
